How long does a handmade kitchen take?

Most handmade kitchens take eight to twelve weeks from the first survey to the final fitting. The exact time depends on the timber, the finish and how busy the workshop is.

The stages

  1. Survey and design: one to two weeks.
  2. Making in the workshop: five to seven weeks.
  3. Fitting: one to two weeks.

We design, build and fit solid wood kitchens, wardrobes and bespoke furniture for homes across West Yorkshire. Every piece is made in our own workshop from sustainably sourced oak, walnut and ash.
